title: Fire-resistance rating for fire separations between resident rooms
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A three-storey combustible building has a Group B, Division 3 care major occupancy. Individual resident rooms each have a bed and washroom; laundry and cooking facilities are not in the rooms.

The dispute concerns whether walls between resident rooms and the remainder of the floor area require fire-resistance ratings; the positions depend on whether rooms are suites or residents’ sleeping rooms.
